resolution: Use CANON.md and IMMEDIATE-CAST-CANON. Hana and Tariq are individually promoted; other proposed records retain proposal status unless another specialist promotion is verified.

description: FO-01 forbids external flags/unit patches; current user requests country badges on black mannequin characters.
resolution: DECIDED 2026-11-03 (DECISIONS-2026-11-03.md §3): Owner-approved (delegated): country badges are on-screen UI only (HUD chip, roster card, World globe card); never on 3D models or textures; ISO alpha-2 chip, no emblems. FO-01 and the no-marks rule stand for models.

description: Current user wants featureless black mannequin characters. Repository documents also contain formal suits, civilian wear, non-human Pylon, and the exceptional PRIM3 helmet.
resolution: Model mannequin body style separately from role, clothing, gear and identity. Do not claim every old reference already used that style.

description: FO-01 permits transitioning directly from CO-02 to external field operations; CO-02 v1.0 requires promotion to Cohort-01 for real external missions.
resolution: Retain current trainee gate and flag legacy FO-01 transition wording.

resolution: DECIDED 2026-11-03 (DECISIONS-2026-11-03.md §4): PROPOSED 0.32 x 0.22 x 0.045 m closed, 2.6 kg; thickness 45 mm (rugged class).

description: closed_dimensions: Conflicting footprints; no automatic conversion makes them equivalent.
resolution: DECIDED 2026-11-03 (DECISIONS-2026-11-03.md §4): PROPOSED 0.14 x 0.08 x 0.022 m, 0.35 kg.

single_cartridge_dimensions: Distinct sources disagree on cartridge footprint.

indicator_semantics: Operational meaning conflicts; do not teach either as verified truth without harmonization.
resolution: Operational meaning conflicts; do not teach either as verified truth without harmonization.

description: max_primary_compute: CANON FIELD-KITS supports one deck. Earlier proposed ceiling differs; retain conflict note.
resolution: CANON FIELD-KITS supports one deck. Earlier proposed ceiling differs; retain conflict note.

description: max_modules: If optional fifth module is equipped, slot rule needs explicit replacement/tradeoff.
resolution: DECIDED 2026-11-03 (DECISIONS-2026-11-03.md §5): PROPOSED: the cap stays 4. The Isolation Sleeve is not a fifth module: when authorized it takes Module D, displacing the Integrity Dongle; the hardened deck does the integrity check in software.

description: units: Visual kit is proposed procedural art; no real-world size or canon approval inferred.
resolution: DECIDED 2026-11-03 (DECISIONS-2026-11-03.md §4): PROPOSED: kit is sized in real metres and every GLB is normalized to its table size (uniform scale).

description: mark_policy: New user direction permits country identity. Record as requested presentation change without silently rewriting old canon references or deriving ability from nationality.
resolution: DECIDED 2026-11-03 (DECISIONS-2026-11-03.md §3): Same as identity.canon.country-patches: UI only, never on models; no stat from nationality.

description: No ammunition type registry, bullet entities, magazines, reserves, caliber, chambering, reload or consumption exists in current runtime.
resolution: Define game-only ammo IDs and compatibility separately; do not infer ammo from model geometry.

description: No equipped weapon instance drives gameplay. Unit aim, damage and attackRange directly resolve attacks. Separate 18-prop GLB kit is visual only.
resolution: Introduce weapon/loadout references and an adapter when implementing equipment gameplay.

description: Runtime has no phenotype ID or phenotype attribute system. E/R/T silhouettes are procedural role branches.
resolution: Join approved phenotype definitions explicitly; preserve prototype role stats.

description: Units have no country or country-badge field. Runtime names do not establish nationality.
resolution: Country and badge references require approved identities.

description: Movement resolves synchronously in the rules engine and then renderer plays events. No player-controlled duck/dodge/run or mid-route equation contest.
resolution: A real-time execution phase would need its own event/state model.

description: Only optional coordinate-distance exercise and route-cost feedback exist. No projectile-arc experiment, graph-line/slope progression or persistent learner record.
resolution: Add learning concept IDs and authored mission exercises separately.

description: There is no fog-of-war or per-unit visibility/detection state. The target list iterates all living enemies; line of sight only gates attacks.
resolution: Add explicit visibility and detection records if reconnaissance is to hide/reveal units.

description: 1,402 default-world rendering parts are grouped visuals, not individually colliding/destructible objects. Geometry is generated from 43 world logical objects plus decoration.
resolution: Use logical object IDs for gameplay and visual part IDs for appearance; do not count each window as a cover object.

description: Default world roof cover differs from compiled Level Forge cover; default containers are blocked at ground and have no traversable roofs, while builder containers are roof surfaces. Custom levels currently omit service gate and medkit interactions.
resolution: Keep level-source-specific rules visible until a unified ruleset is deliberately implemented.
